Hi Sarah — thanks for sending these over and for the clear packet. Quick next steps from procurement so we can create the vendor record and route POs correctly: 

1) We need either a completed bank verification form (DocuSign preferred) or a secure share of bank account details for ACH setup. Please use the DocuSign link below if possible.
2) Confirm that the remit address in the packet is the address you want on POs.
3) Confirm point of contact for PO questions (name and phone).

What I'll do: loop in AP and create a vendor master record once we have the bank verification. Neha (cc'd) will own the vendor record creation and will reply when a vendor ID is assigned. Typical turnaround is 24-48 business hours after receipt of bank verification.

DocuSign for bank verification: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123456
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-00089

Appreciate it — Neha, can you take point on creating the record once Sarah confirms the DocuSign completion? Marcus, flag if we need special PO routing.

Best,
Rachel Kim
